Open to review them.'; the older cards mount only while the fold is open; 'No one from the last 2 days is waiting.' when only older callers wait, 'All Caught Up!' only when the whole list is empty; the call list's filter row has one chip per label (one 'Other'), counted from the loaded list so the chips add up to 'All', and 'Showing the newest 200 of N calls in the last 7 days.' when the list is capped; outcome bars summed by label; the today card is titled 'Today so far' with 'Updated 5:22 PM. This card always shows today, whatever range is picked below.', 'N scored, N not scored yet', 'From the AI's read of the call', 'Scored calls included'; '(a lead, callback or booking was saved)' replaces the leadId/callbackId/bookingId text; the gamified Achievements card (LVL, streak, GOLD badges) is gone; an empty Follow-Up Caller transfer reads 'No number set'; chips, the fold summary and Reset filters are 48 px.
